facilities.name: Baxter — North Cove
facilities.address: Marion, North Carolina, United States — city-level location only
facilities.coordinate_precision: City reference, not verified facility point
facilities.site_case: Hurricane Helene flooded North Cove in September 2024; production was interrupted and later restored.
facilities.data_gaps: City-level coordinates only. Official FDA FEI, property boundary, pre-event site flood exposure, insured asset value, and coverage terms are not validated in this public demonstration.

facilities.name: Pfizer — Rocky Mount
facilities.address: Rocky Mount, North Carolina, United States — city-level location only
facilities.coordinate_precision: City reference, not verified facility point
facilities.site_case: July 2023 tornado damaged the HiRise warehouse and disrupted operations; manufacturing restarted in stages.
facilities.data_gaps: City-level coordinates only. Official site FEI and building boundary have not been crosswalked. Tornado occurrence and plant damage are confirmed; a predictive tornado-site exposure score is not provided.

facilities.name: Amgen — Juncos
facilities.address: Juncos, Puerto Rico — city-level location only
facilities.coordinate_precision: City reference, not verified facility point
facilities.site_case: Hurricane Maria caused some site damage in 2017; production relied on backup power and water contingencies while medicine supply continued.
facilities.data_gaps: City-level coordinates only. No site engineering survey, insurer loss record, verified FEI, or full restoration-cost attribution is included.

evidence.finding: Baxter confirmed Hurricane Helene flooding at North Cove and a production shutdown while assessing damage and recovery.
evidence.limitations: Retrospective event documentation. Not proof the event could have been anticipated from available site-level hazard layers.

evidence.record_type: Property damage, production and insurance impacts
evidence.finding: 2024 charges included $44 million damaged inventory/assets and $317 million other response costs, partially offset by $251 million of insurance recoveries; net pre-tax charges were $110 million.
evidence.evidence_scope: North Cove hurricane impacts disclosed at issuer level
evidence.limitations: Disclosure published after the event. Components and recoveries must not be summed again across quarterly and annual filings.

evidence.finding: Baxter reported North Cove was fully operational by the end of first-quarter 2025.
evidence.limitations: Full operation is a production-status claim and does not establish full restoration of every affected asset.

evidence.finding: Baxter estimated a negative fourth-quarter 2024 sales impact of about $200 million from North Cove hurricane disruption, across medical products and kidney care.
evidence.limitations: Forward estimate, not a realized insured loss. Avoid combining with later audited cost data.

evidence.finding: Pfizer confirmed a July 19 tornado damaged the manufacturing site, primarily its warehouse; the plant temporarily closed for assessment.
evidence.limitations: After-event release; does not establish pre-event site-specific tornado forecastability.

evidence.finding: Pfizer restarted the majority of manufacturing lines following the July tornado; full restart was planned in stages.
evidence.limitations: Operational plan at publication date; not independently audited recovery completion.

evidence.finding: Pfizer recorded $286 million in cost of sales for damaged inventory, overhead during downtime, and incremental tornado-related costs in 2023; partial insurance recoveries were recognized.
evidence.evidence_scope: Named Rocky Mount plant / issuer accounting
evidence.limitations: Accounting expense and recoveries are not equivalent to insured property loss or the amount an insurer paid.

evidence.finding: ICU Medical identified Rocky Mount as a Pfizer manufacturing supplier and disclosed that tornado damage affected warehouse and inventory, creating a potential supply-chain consequence.
evidence.evidence_scope: Named supplier site in customer filing
evidence.limitations: Quarter-end report describes a post-quarter tornado. Raw report period must not be interpreted as pre-event availability.

evidence.finding: Amgen stated critical manufacturing areas at Juncos were not significantly impacted and expected continuity of medicine supply after Hurricane Maria.
evidence.limitations: Initial assessment and forecast; longer-term impact requires follow-up.

evidence.finding: Amgen reported operating backup generators supplied under pre-arranged fuel contracts, plus on-site water wells/tanks and backup communications; supply to patients remained uninterrupted.
evidence.limitations: Describes stated contingency measures at that time, not a validated property protection score.

evidence.finding: Amgen reported some site damage without significant impact to critical production areas, continued medicine supply, backup generators through the end of 2017 and reconnecting to the grid in January 2018.
evidence.evidence_scope: Named Juncos site in issuer filing
evidence.limitations: Full site damage and insured expenses are not quantified in this excerpt.

sec_findings.finding: Hurricane Helene flood damages and operations disruption reported by Baxter.
sec_findings.financial_impact: 2024: $44M inventory/assets write-off + $317M response expenses − $251M recoveries = $110M pre-tax net charge.
sec_findings.attribution: Named North Cove manufacturing site; figures are issuer reporting lines, not insurer claims.
sec_findings.caveats: Do not double count across quarterly and annual disclosures.

sec_findings.finding: Sterile injectable production and warehouse affected by July 2023 tornado.
sec_findings.financial_impact: $286M charged to cost of sales in 2023; partial insurance recoveries received.
sec_findings.insurance_recovery: Partial, amount not established in this public demo
sec_findings.caveats: Reported accounting loss is not a validated insurance claim.

sec_findings.finding: Hurricane caused some damage while Amgen maintained uninterrupted medicine supply using backup infrastructure.
sec_findings.financial_impact: No facility-specific insured property loss established in this public demo.
sec_findings.attribution: Named Juncos plant; continuity should not be mistaken for absence of physical damage.
sec_findings.caveats: Not an independently verified no-claim control.

important_caveats: Public demonstration contains newly curated primary-source examples, not the analyst workbook or live SQLite database.
Location points are approximate city references and must not be used for facility geofencing, flood overlays or property risk scoring.
Event and reporting-period dates must not be substituted for when facts became publicly available.
SEC costs and recoveries may overlap in later disclosures; do not sum rows as unique insured losses.
A demonstrated incident or business-continuity response is not an actuarially calibrated predictor of a future claim.
The hosted Pages site has no backend and cannot perform live government data ingestion.
